reviews.text: Chris was beyond amazing. He did exactly what he promised & got our 10 month old Goldendoodle puppy to behave on a leash. Within 5 minutes of dropping him off for his first day, he had already gotten him to stop jumping, so I knew he was in good hands. After 10 days of training and now nearly 3 weeks at home, our pup listens to every command taught to him while on his lease. Walking him is now a breeze and he’s so well adjusted now that other dog walkers constantly point out how well behaved he is. His 1 hour lesson after the 10 day stay was simple, direct and covered everything we needed to know to continue his training. His facility was beautiful and a great location to make our pup feel at home. HIGHLY recommend Chris to anyone even considering this kind of training.

We took a rambunctious rescue dog to Chris at Stronghaus and he returned a more disciplined, calm and manageable pup without losing all his qualities that make him a great dog. This is my third rescue Chris has successfully trained. He is simply the best.
Lisa & Brian

My husband and I recently used Stronghaus for training our 1-year-old pit/lab mix.  Chris was absolutely amazing.  Our dog went from pulling on a leash to walking by our side effortlessly. He used to jump on people when he was excited, but now he tries to jump, and you give him the command, and he listens.  Chris worked with us when we went to pick up our dog.  Chris is just as good at training the owners as he is with the dogs. I 100% recommend his services.

This trainer is real greedy for no reason. I paid $1800 for 10 days of training, I asked the dog trainer to take a couple pictures through out the training, and he told me he would charge me a photographer fee for that, additionally I dropped my dog 02/23 5 pm, and he wants me to pick it up on the 10th day at 9 am, even though i told him I had a work emergency, he told me he was supposed to charge me $36000 or something outrageous
Best in the business.    I would not send my dog anywhere else.

I have a 1 and 1/2 year old female Rottweilers who had a terrible pulling problem while on walks. She has some non listing issues along with bitting problems and stubbornness. When I went for a evaluation in less than 15 minutes right infront of me she stopped pulled and whole attitude changed. Very pleased with the 10 day board and train now its my turn to make our bond stronger. Thanks Chris

Chris and his team are true professionals in the dog training world. He trained my childhood Rottweiler many years ago and now recently my wife and I sent our Rottweiler puppy, Arrow, to him and he did amazing work with her as well. He’s friendly, personable, a great communicator and most importantly a fantastic dog trainer! A true generational dog trainer.

We took our 7 month old Rottie here for a 10 board and training program and we were not disappointed. Chris is professional, respectful, and most importantly knowledgeable on not only training your dog but transferring that knowledge to the owner to continue their progress at home. Do not expect to pick up your dog and all of your issues disappear where you as the owner do not need to work on it anymore. As the owner of your dog, YOU must continue to reinforce the training at home. A few days after pick up and we are continuing the commands and training at home and we are pleased with the results. I'd recommend him to anyone looking for long term structure and discipline for their pup.

Going to see Chris is a MUST if you are a dog owner, even an experienced one. In just five weeks, I feel like I have a different dog, all because of how I was taught to do things differently. For the record, I grew up with dogs, trainers, etc., and thought I knew how to do things, but this experience was necessary. I am glad I stayed open-minded and did what I thought was best for my great dane puppy.

Having a dog is delightful enough but having one who listens to commands while creating a respectful relationship is a whole new level of happiness. Do EVERYONE a favor and go see Chris. He is professional, intelligent, and I am pretty sure has magical powers.

After my husband passed away, my dogs and I were struggling to find a new sense of balance. The grief and stress had affected all of us, and their behavior started to shift in ways I didn’t always know how to handle. That’s when I found Chris, and I can honestly say he has been a lifesaver for our little family.

Chris is not just an incredible dog trainer—he is compassionate, patient, and truly understands the emotional connection between people and their pets. He helped me rebuild structure and confidence, both for myself and for my dogs, and his guidance brought much-needed stability and peace back into our lives.

My dogs and I are beyond grateful for his support. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a trainer who truly cares.

I couldn’t say more good things about the results Chris gets, even with a difficult puppy. Other trainers I called mostly focused on socialization and being calm for puppies under 6 months. Chris really turned about my 4 month old puppy and saved me so much frustration. He has 40 years experience and it shows. I would highly recommend Chris.

I am so grateful my vet recommended Chris Carr of Stronghauss  for training of my Belgian Malinois puppy. I must admit, I have heard stories of how strong minded this breed can be but due to my “I can do anything attitude” decided I could walk this training path alone. Well I learned real quick I couldn’t. Chris immediately set up an initial meeting with me to assess my puppy. He had some aggression issues that carried over to disobedience and not listening to anything I wanted him to do. I was quite nervous at first wondering if I took on too much and if Chris would be able to help. Well let me tell you that within the 10 days of boarding, coming back to pick up my dog he can do a perfect heel, lay down, sit, place command, and inside command. He holds all commands until his release command of okay. I cannot believe the difference and I am so happy that I have the support.  Chris and I will continue working on my proper dog ownership techniques as well as being a support system if I have questions. Very happy dog and dog mama here!!!!!!

I took my dog to Chris after years of bad behavior. She wouldn’t listen 75% of the time to basic commands like sit, down, heel, come, etc. She was very bad. she’s had about three years to literally do whatever she wants with no discipline …

Chris worked miracles on my leash-pulling, fence-jumping,  deer-chasing hound mix. James is now obedient and responsive to my commands and has learned his boundaries in my backyard. Most importantly, I can contact Chris whenever I have any questions or concerns even after training. Many thanks to Chris and his staff!

Chris is fantastic. I recently adopted a dog and was nervous about integrating him into my home with the existing dog. Chris came to my home and walked me through the process.  I now have two happy coexisting dogs and I couldn't be happier. It definitely wouldn't have gone as smooth without his expertise and guidance.
Absolutely great trainer and staff!!! Would highly recommend to anyone I knew looking for a trainer. Nova surpassed all of my expectations for the board and train. The right way to train dogs 👍🏽 …
What a difference in Max. Thank you Chris! Max went from a hyper puppy to a calm puppy without losing his personality.
